changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO vacancy (id, employer_id, title, description, category, city, salary_from, salary_to, currency, employment_type, status, moderation_status, positions_count, positions_filled, source, created_at, updated_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), e.id, CASE (random()*13)::int WHEN 0 THEN 'Oshpaz kerak' WHEN 1 THEN 'Haydovchi' WHEN 2 THEN 'Sotuvchi-kassir' WHEN 3 THEN 'Quruvchi-ishchi' WHEN 4 THEN 'Tozalovchi' WHEN 5 THEN 'Ofitsiant' WHEN 6 THEN 'Omborchi' WHEN 7 THEN 'Qorovul' WHEN 8 THEN 'Elektrik ustasi' WHEN 9 THEN 'Santexnik' WHEN 10 THEN 'Tikuvchi' WHEN 11 THEN 'Kuryer' WHEN 12 THEN 'Yukchi' ELSE 'Ishchi kerak' END, 'Bu demo vakansiya. Tajribali xodim kerak. Ish sharoitlari qulay. Maosh o''z vaqtida to''lanadi.', CASE (random()*13)::int WHEN 0 THEN 'COOK' WHEN 1 THEN 'DRIVER' WHEN 2 THEN 'SALES' WHEN 3 THEN 'BUILDER' WHEN 4 THEN 'CLEANER' WHEN 5 THEN 'WAITER' WHEN 6 THEN 'WAREHOUSE' WHEN 7 THEN 'SECURITY' WHEN 8 THEN 'ELECTRICIAN' WHEN 9 THEN 'PLUMBER' WHEN 10 THEN 'TAILOR' WHEN 11 THEN 'COURIER' WHEN 12 THEN 'LOADER' ELSE 'OTHER' END, CASE (random()*7)::int WHEN 0 THEN 'Tashkent' WHEN 1 THEN 'Samarkand' WHEN 2 THEN 'Bukhara' WHEN 3 THEN 'Andijan' WHEN 4 THEN 'Namangan' WHEN 5 THEN 'Fergana' WHEN 6 THEN 'Nukus' ELSE 'Karshi' END, (2000000 + (random()*3000000)::int)::numeric, (5000000 + (random()*5000000)::int)::numeric, 'UZS', 'FULL_TIME', 'ACTIVE', 'APPROVED', (1 + (random()*9)::int), 0, 'MANUAL', now() - (random()*30||' days')::interval, now() FROM employer e, generate_series(1, 100) WHERE e.inn LIKE 'DEMO%' LIMIT 500;
